question: What is the sum of ((3)/(8)) + ((5)/(12))
solution:
The correct answer is __((19)/(24))__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To find the sum of two fractions, convert them to a common denominator and then add.
 
• The fractions given are ((3)/(8)) and ((5)/(12)).
 
• The least common denominator (LCD) of 8 and 12 is 24.
 
• Convert ((3)/(8)) to ((9)/(24)) and ((5)/(12)) to ((10)/(24)).
 
• Add the fractions: ((9)/(24)) + ((10)/(24)) = ((19)/(24)).
 
• The result is ((19)/(24)), which matches Option 1.
